narrative.title: Journey to a World-Class Developer Platform
narrative.currentState: Our platform has strong foundations in CI/CD and Kubernetes, but developers struggle with service discovery, observability gaps, and manual deployment processes.
narrative.turningPoint: By investing in GitOps, distributed tracing, and a comprehensive developer portal, we can transform how teams build and operate services.
narrative.destination: By end of 2026, developers will have a self-service platform with automated deployments, full observability, and secure service-to-service communication - enabling them to ship 3x faster with higher reliability.

journey.headline: Laying the Foundation
journey.story: We're implementing GitOps with ArgoCD and rolling out OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing. These foundational capabilities will enable the automation and visibility needed for subsequent improvements.
journey.userImpact: Developers get declarative deployments and basic tracing capabilities

journey.headline: Developer Experience Acceleration
journey.story: With foundations in place, we're enhancing the developer portal and beginning service mesh rollout. Golden path templates will make it trivial to create new services with best practices baked in.
journey.userImpact: Developers can self-service new services, trace requests end-to-end, and benefit from mTLS

journey.headline: Platform Maturity
journey.story: We're completing our vision with feature flags for safe deployments, progressive delivery capabilities, and advanced observability powered by ML-based anomaly detection.
journey.userImpact: Teams can safely deploy features to subsets of users and get proactive alerts before incidents occur

narrative.callToAction: Partner with Platform Engineering to onboard your services to GitOps and distributed tracing today - you'll be ready to leverage feature flags and progressive delivery when they launch in Q4.
